features: WITHHELD TWICE FROM THE SAME SUPPLIER — When a building association pays for renovation work by «bonifico parlante», the transfer whose reference cites the statute in order to claim the tax deductions, the withholding is operated by THE BANK and not by the association: applying both would mean withholding twice on the same payment. The software already had the «Bonifico Parlante» checkbox on the payment, the deduction type, the beneficiaries, and even the exclusion reason — the withholding calculation simply never read that flag.
NO DATABASE CHANGES: no migrations, no new columns.

Fixed — WITH A «BONIFICO PARLANTE» THE ASSOCIATION STILL WITHHELD THE ADVANCE TAX. The supplier received 4% less than due, and that same amount ended up in the schedule as payable to the Revenue Agency while the bank had already operated its own withholding on the same sum. A payment marked as «bonifico parlante» now withholds nothing: the supplier receives the full amount and nothing enters the F24. The invoice keeps the withholding it had computed, and that is not an oversight: when the invoice is registered nobody yet knows how it will be paid, and it is the payment method that removes it — indeed the same invoice can be paid in two instalments, a deposit by ordinary transfer and the balance by «bonifico parlante».

SINCE WHEN, AND HOW TO CHECK: since the checkbox has existed, so from before the F24 module. While the withholding was only a snapshot for the annual certificate the harm was limited to the supplier; since the schedule exists it also became a sum proposed to the Revenue Agency. In the supplier payments list, those marked as «bonifico parlante» showing a non-zero withholding are the affected ones: the supplier received less than due.

Fixed — IN EDIT MODE, UNTICKING THE BOX NOW RESTORES THE WITHHOLDING THE INVOICES CALL FOR. Without it, it would have stayed at zero forever and the association would have stopped withholding without anyone deciding so. The recalculation only happens when the box actually changes, so no payment that does not touch it gets rewritten as a side effect.

Fixed — THE RATE OF THE WITHHOLDING OPERATED BY THE BANK WAS STATED AS 8%. It rose to 11% for transfers made from 1 March 2024. It affects no calculation, since that withholding is paid by the bank and never enters our F24, but it was the only place the number was written and it was the old one. The Agency's own public page still says 8%: it is the page that is out of date.

WHAT YOU WILL SEE: ticking «Bonifico Parlante» on a payment to a supplier subject to withholding now shows a notice stating the consequence while you choose, not afterwards — that the association will withhold nothing, that the bank operates the withholding, and that the supplier will receive the full amount. It blocks nothing: this is money changing route, and whoever decides must know before pressing save.

Under the hood: the exclusion reason is not stored in a column, it is derived — a payment with the box ticked and zero withholding IS an exclusion by «bonifico parlante», and an extra field would say the same thing with the possibility of diverging. The beta.38 consistency guard would have blocked exactly the correct save, because the edit screen sends back the already-stored withholding, which after a change of the box is by construction the old one: it now stands down only when the choice changes, in both directions, and outside that case stays as strict as before. Eleven new tests, including one verifying that the case is actually reachable.
